skip_reason: Existing-relationship service/booking call, not a new inbound sales call. Terri from Agape Home Services (a referral partner that repeatedly books moves with Einstein) calls to (1) add a day of packing/prep onto an already-scheduled move for an existing job on file, and (2) schedule a second, separate repeat move for another client (Grant Foxworth) that Agape has used Einstein for before. Chris just pulls up existing records, confirms dates/addresses, gives a rough hourly time estimate, and books both jobs by phone/email follow-up. There is no new-customer discovery, pricing/differentiators pitch, clock explanation, full estimate walkthrough, or Save Your Ass speech anywhere in the transcript — it's operational scheduling, not a sales call.
